name: 下水道事業条例の引用条項を整理
summary: 下水道事業の設置などを定める条例を改正します。地方自治法の改正に合わせ、条例で引用している条項を整理します。
changes: 条例で引用する地方自治法の条項を整理する
why: 地方自治法の改正に伴い、引用条項を整理するためと、市は説明しています。

en.name: Organizes cited provisions in the sewerage business ordinance
en.official: Regarding the Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance on the Establishment, etc. of Kokubunji City Sewerage Business
en.summary: The city will amend the ordinance that sets out the establishment, etc. of its sewerage business. In line with amendments to the Local Autonomy Act, it will organize the provisions cited in the ordinance.
changes: Organizes the provisions of the Local Autonomy Act cited in the ordinance
en.why: The city says this is to organize the cited provisions following amendments to the Local Autonomy Act.
